The '''Shooting Gallery''' was a [[Complex]] obstacle used on a [[swoopchasing]] course. An Outlaw-level variant of the [[Kessel Run (swoopchasing)|Kessel Run]], it added a degree of difficulty by incorporating five to eight mounted weapons, such as [[E-Web heavy repeating blaster/Legends|E-Web heavy repeating blasters]].<ref name="BSS" />
